blurb: Guests can rent motorized and non-motorized boats, participate in water skiing, wakeboarding, wakesurfing, and sailing activities, or enroll children in a watersports day camp. Motorboat rentals require a minimum age of 21 and a $1000 credit card deposit. The day camp offers a full day of water activities for children aged 7 to 12, including skiing, wakeboarding, sailing, and tubing.
